 Monica Barbaro, 36, stuns in daring plunging dress that nearly reaches her waist at GQ party
 The Oscar-nominated actress made a revealing red-carpet appearance at the star-studded event, where boyfriend Andrew Garfield was among the night's honorees
 Nicola Conville Features Writer 10 hours ago Nov 13, 2026, 9:17 PM GMT LEAVE A COMMENT 
 Monica Barbaro certainly wasn't afraid to make a statement as she stepped out in a daring dress for GQ's Men of the Year party in Los Angeles on Thursday night.
 The 36-year-old actress commanded attention in an eye-catching black-and-white creation featuring an extremely plunging neckline that extended almost to her waist.
 The Top Gun: Maverick star looked sensational in the sleeveless Brandon Maxwell design, which featured a fitted black bodice with dramatic side cutouts and a contrasting white pleated skirt that fell below her knees.
 © Getty Images Monica attends the GQ Men of the year party 2026 
 Monica completed the striking ensemble with pointed black patent heels and sparkling earrings, allowing the dramatic neckline to take center stage.
 She wore her glossy brunette hair swept into a deep side part, with soft waves cascading over one shoulder, and opted for understated makeup with rosy cheeks and a nude lip.
 © Variety via Getty Images Monica wore a daring but chic gown for the occasion

 Monica Barbaro joins boyfriend Andrew Garfield at GQ Men of the Year party
 The actress was among the famous faces attending the glamorous celebration at the Chateau Marmont, where her boyfriend Andrew Garfield , 43, was one of the evening's three featured Men of the Year.
 © FilmMagic Andrew was presented with an award on the night 
 Although the couple posed separately on the red carpet, their joint attendance marked another public outing for the notoriously private pair, who have been romantically linked since early 2025.
 Andrew, who was recognized as GQ's Performer of the Year, looked dapper in a sharply tailored suit by Edward Sexton.
 The two actors have also worked together on the upcoming movie Artificial, while Monica previously earned an Academy Award nomination for her portrayal of Joan Baez in A Complete Unknown .
 Matt Damon, Chris Rock and more stars attend GQ Men of the Year 2026
 Monica was in good company at the annual celebration, which brought together some of Hollywood's biggest names.
 © Getty Images Matt Damon with wife and Luciana Barroso 
 Matt Damon, 56, who was recognized as GQ's Leading Man of the Year, attended with his wife Luciana Barroso, while fellow honoree Chris Rock, 61, opted for a classic tailored look.
 © FilmMagic Jason Bateman with wife Amanda Anka at Chateau Marmont 
 Jason Bateman was also joined by his wife Amanda Anka, while Cara Delevingne embraced menswear-inspired glamour in a Saint Laurent suit.
 © FilmMagic Delilah Belle sported an animal-print ensemble 
 Other guests included Halle Bailey, Scout and Rumer Willis, Delilah Belle Hamlin, Tinashe and Ayo Edebiri.
